SECTION_DEPS_DESC.engagement-context: The contractual frame (MSC/MSI/STA) cascades nine coefficients: ramp speed & cap into the S-curve, glass factor into the master formula, setup-billable into the Setup split, MC-widen into the Monte Carlo spread and the risk premium into the Decision Intelligence bar. It also caps reachable maturity, gates knowledge-hub eligibility and commercial-model availability. The case NPV discount rate lives here too.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.transform-params: The industry / regulatory profile injects its regulatory artefacts into the scope, which raises the effort-weighted glass ceiling on its own rather than by assertion; cross-cutting concerns (AI, sustainability, usability) stack on top and interact with the AI-Act tier in Risk.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.engage: The four onboarding stage durations (Discover → Pilot & Prove) set the delivery-window origin: everything downstream of onboarding-end shifts with them on the Gantt, and the point at which the adoption ramp is allowed to climb.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.params: The two depth levers — automation potential and the effective glass ceiling — set effective automation, which cascades into the workforce trajectory, the Operating-model volume, Setup/Run costs, the Financial savings, the Abaque reconciliation and both comparison views.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.scope-sel: The in-scope artefact set drives per-phase automation & supervision (Phase/Artifact), the vFTE build-up, Setup/Run effort, the Financial savings and the Abaque reconciliation. It is also what derives the glass ceiling and (under auto-fit) the automation potential.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.phase-scope: The coarse phase toggles write to the same artefact selection that Scope edits per-artefact — same state, two resolutions.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.scurve: The adoption ramp sets when the automation lands: it shapes the monthly trajectory the workforce, run cost and savings are read from, feeds the Monte Carlo's most-sampled parameters, and its horizon drives every end-year figure in the app.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.lc-weighting: The product-status position re-weights every phase's effort (changing the effort-weighted ceiling and scope share) and applies an automation posture to effective automation.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.team-in: The AS-IS team sizes the FTE/vFTE trajectory, the Operating-model pods, Setup/Run costs and the Financial baseline; it is also the base for the HRI change cost and the AgentOps platform floor.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.ratecard: Rates convert effort into money for Setup, Run, the Financial view and the Commercial-model P&L.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.loc-strat: The target location mix sets the blended day rate the residual team is costed at (targetBlendedTJM), feeding Setup, Run and the Financial view directly.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.maturity-map: The single definition of the L1–L4 thresholds. Every maturity marker and read-out — the adoption curve, the automation graph, the FTE/vFTE chart and the engine's own level computation — reads this table live.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.readiness: The Human Readiness Index applies an adoption drag to the S-curve (FTE/vFTE), adds a change cost to Setup, and flags a human-readiness risk in Decision Intelligence.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.lifecycle-edit: The unified product profile (EV-13) applies one coefficient per phase, re-weighting FTE/vFTE effort AND driving the Eligibility potential matrix — a single source feeding both.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.knowledge: The Knowledge hub (CC0–CC4) multiplies the automation potential (FTE/vFTE), narrows the Monte Carlo adoption spread, adds hub setup/run cost and avoided-KT savings (Financial), and lifts the P10 in Decision Intelligence.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.token-econ: Token pricing & mix set the LLM run cost that flows into Agentic Run and the Financial view.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.run-sizing: The agentic run-team sizing policy (hybrid floor + per-agent formula) sets the AgentOps headcount and cost, feeding Agentic Run and the Financial view.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.agent-dir: The external-rework-loop toggle subtracts its rework cost from the Financial savings. The internal-loop toggle is informational only and carries no economic edge, by design.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.eligibility: The eligibility gate annotates Decision Intelligence (go/conditional/no-go); the Abaque A/B reconciliation and the verification tax, when applied, deduct from the Financial savings.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.maturity: SDD maturity cuts the verification tax (Eligibility) and mitigates the AI code-quality premium (Risk). Coaching, the measurement socle and the governance gates are analytical (no economic edge).
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.risk: The agentic risk register, the AI-Act tier and the AI code-quality premium raise the Decision Intelligence bar; the quality premium also multiplies the verification tax (Eligibility).
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.setup: The one-off investment (tooling, change, hub) feeds the Financial view and the payback — it is the ROI denominator.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.fte-vfte: The workforce trajectory (residual FTE + agent vFTE, conserved against the input team) — a relay: it owns no inputs, but the trajectory it presents flows on to the Operating model, Setup/Run costs, the Financial view and the target-team and AS-IS/TO-BE comparison surfaces. Its own drivers are Input team, Automation & Glass ceiling, the S-curve, Scope, the lifecycle axis and the Knowledge hub.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.phase-art: The per-phase human/agent supervision split sets the Run supervision cost, the verification-tax base (Eligibility) and the supervision-matrix input to Risk.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.opmodel: The pod/transverse topology re-projects the residual volume (V7, no double count) and feeds the Program multi-pod views.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.run: The recurring run cost (team, tokens, infra, supervision, hub) feeds the Financial view and the savings.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.financial: ROI, savings and cost feed the Commercial-model margin, the Decision Intelligence verdict, the KPI cascade and the Program pilot cost.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.montecarlo: The probabilistic spread produces the P10/P50/P90 that the Decision Intelligence verdict reads.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.decision: The confidence-conditional verdict frames the Program go/no-go.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.commercial: The chosen selling model and its margin — a presentation surface over the Financial result; drives nothing downstream.
SECTION_DEPS_DESC.kpi: The KPI scorecard feeds the Decision-Intelligence context.
